name: freellmapi
description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
one_liner: A tool that stitches together dozens of free AI providers' free tiers into one single API key, explicitly for personal experimentation.
buyer: An indie hacker or student prototyping an AI app who doesn't want to pay for API calls yet.
business_use_cases: A student builds a class project chatbot without paying for any LLM API calls.
An indie developer prototypes an AI feature across many different models before picking one to actually pay for in production.

money_ideas.idea: None that hold up honestly — the project itself says "personal experimentation only," and reselling access built on stacked free tiers breaks the terms of service of the very providers it aggregates.

steal_this: Use this to prototype your AI app for free this weekend before you spend a dollar on real API costs — but don't try to build a resellable product on top of it.
